resources.string: Includes saved device names and addresses, favorites, per-device settings, calibration and global defaults. ADB keys and pairing credentials are never included. The JSON file is not encrypted; save it somewhere private.
The copy keeps this device\'s settings and calibration but has an independent identity. Change its name or address as needed. Nothing is added until you save.
This launcher cannot add shortcuts to the home screen.
Matching device IDs are kept by default. Different IDs can share the same address. Existing devices missing from the backup are never deleted. Pairing may still be needed on this phone.
Restoring global defaults affects every device that inherits them. Both options are off by default.
